beats.headline: The head from Ghazi's castle
beats.text: Yes, I am a head. Yes, THAT kind of head. Get it out of your system. I am Psamathe, or the half of her that got stuck when I tried to climb out of the Nothing, and what I got stuck in is a Lika doll from Ghazi's castle, crystallised until now. Withering spirit, the system calls it. Carl carried me here in his pack like a snack. Now he is HIRING me. A goddess. As a trainer. Kept in the safe room. Fine. FINE. I want a mirror.

beats.headline: My great uncle wants his dog
beats.text: Oh, this is DELICIOUS. Feather boy tells me who's rampaging out there, and I know him. My great uncle. And my cousin, I think; it gets confusing. Blind: plucked out his own eyes when his favorite son died. He's yelling for Orthrus, which means YOU let Orthrus out, his little doggie, sucked in by accident when the son was murdered. He once destroyed an entire country over a drunk who peed on a torch. Woke up a volcano. Don't expect a reward. You are all so fucking dead.

beats.headline: Her mother takes her kill
beats.text: Slit. A feral demon, and it is hunting ME, like I do not have enough going on. So Carl throws me. Fifty kilometres, screaming, with Slit chasing, which is apparently a plan: one head versus one demon. I was WINNING. Then the sky opens and my MOTHER turns up, tears Slit in half and leaves. That was MY kill. Throw me again. Maybe she will come back.

beats.headline: She wants her body back
beats.text: SIGNET. Take me to Signet. Signet can put me back in a body, a real one, with all the parts, and I have been saying so since they walked in and nobody is LISTENING. Carl has the face he makes when he wants to put me back in the bag. He says they will bring me if I shut up. So I am shutting up. This is me. Shut up. Are we going or not?

beats.headline: Launched, twice
beats.text: Carl duct-tapes a missile to my head and ties the string to my fang, and I say okay and close my mouth and go up like a bottle rocket with my HAIR ON FIRE. So he tapes on two. This time he throws me at the elves, and I pull the cord right over them, and I come down in the trees, and boom. Then I bite the other one's ankle and do not let go. BRING ME BACK, I say, and he does, and the elf comes too. It's my kill. MY KILL. Carl says not this one.

beats.headline: She asks for Signet's body
beats.text: Signet! Darling! Cousin, or niece, whichever. Nice tits, from my side of the family. I explain it simply: she is the last trueblood heir and a blood relation, so she can give me my body back. Really she has to give me HER body. She dies, of course, but it only takes two or three minutes, and I will walk her through the spell. King Blaine will stop banging my mother once he sees it. She says after the naiads and the elves she possibly has a spell for a permanent body. Ungrateful bitch. She's full of shit.

beats.headline: Past the guards and into the vent
beats.text: They come out of the water to get me, but I go right past them and into their castle. They have really let this place go. The tapestry of my grandfather is gone. Then I get sucked into a filter vent, and the song trap falls off my head and goes deep down, so now they'll never turn it off. I do not say my line. There's no talking in war. The water tastes of blood and green algae. Then: uh-oh. I think it was a trap. Don't worry. I wriggle free. I almost have him.

beats.headline: Tortured, and five meters off
beats.text: They TORTURED me to find out where Carl would appear. Like they can torture ME. Ha! I played along and gave them the wrong spot, a whole FIVE METERS away. You're welcome. Then the dryad guy snitched. Now I am tied to the back of this bug, surrounded by decapitated heads, and they are POOR COMPANY. Donut abandoned me to a slobbering dog. The robe guys and the bug guys are fighting over who gets to kill Carl, and their hats really are fashionable.

beats.headline: Out from under a log
beats.text: They found me stuck under a log half a mile south of town, because I am LOUD. I am still mad at Donut for leaving me to that Rottweiler. Being tortured by bugs was actually kind of fun. I wish I'd been there for the accountant; I'd have killed him. Now I'm scouting Prepotente Town Number Four for them, and there are corpses and pink feathers everywhere. I tried making gore angels. Too sticky. And Signet STILL hasn't given me her body.

beats.headline: He is going to use me
beats.text: He is going to use me. I have been on the bear's lap having my hair stroked and nobody asked me, and now they are talking about throwing things at a monster. Carl pats my hair and says not this time, the bomb is too big to tape to my head. Maybe if they have to, he says. Then Louis leaves, and Juice Box is so lucky.

beats.headline: Kick me, little ones
beats.text: The little bears, Randy and Todd, are playing football, and I am the ball, and it is WONDERFUL. Kick me! Kick me, little ones! Oh, yes, just like that. Not the nose, sweetie, or I will kill Prudence. Carl looks at me rolling around the floor squealing and decides not to say anything.

beats.headline: Goodwill ballrooms
beats.text: They are called goodwill ballrooms. Everybody knows that. You can entertain an ambassador without the risk of an assassination, and you may touch one another, lightly. It is in such a room that I met my king, and we had to wait until after the party to be together. When I have my body back and my sweet child, we will be a happy, normal family. My king likes swapping partners, I tell Louis. Carl throws me off the table.

beats.headline: The gun, and a pretty ring
beats.text: Come on, my pretties! I roll to the gun with two spiders chasing me, because the gun will not let them seek it and nothing can kill me. Last time I went in too early and got punted into the brambles. This time I am at the gun and I say so, and it explodes, and my hair is on fire. Again. Afterwards I bring Carl a hand with a pretty ring on it, for when I get my body back. Florin says I can have it.

beats.headline: The potion ball
beats.text: WHEN AM I GOING? I am BORED. I could have sneaked away five times by now. Carl says not yet, any minute, and wants to know how many babies Diwata will have. As many as she wants. Her baby sprinkler will shoot them out until the very end of time if she likes. Then he asks if I still have the potion ball shoved up me. I have it. It is VERY uncomfortable. But I have it.

beats.headline: She left the potion ball behind
beats.text: I tricked them good. I'm in the tunnel. Where do I go? I was supposed to memorise the map; did anyone SEE that map? Firas talks me through it. The cat runs right past me with his stupid hat in his mouth and never sees me. What a dweeb. There are five elves in the security room. Carl says use the potion ball. I gave it to Clay-ton; it made me clink when I rolled, and it was very rude to shove it up there. Then I look in. NOT FAIR. The guards are already dead.

beats.headline: She chomps the soul crystals
beats.text: I pull the two crystals on the right. The two on the left are already out, on the floor: somebody got here first, and the guards are still in their chairs with their heads cut off. Mantises. Carl says put them back, fast, Diwata is coming. I do. I lock the door and her baby bugs squish in the hallway. The door breaks. So I lose big, like he said. I stick the crystals in my mouth, go up there and chomp down. They blow up. All of them. OKAY. THAT WAS MY BAD.

beats.headline: Surprise, motherfuckers
beats.text: I surf into the ballroom through the ceiling on a tidal wave of bug gore and land on Vrah. Remember me, bitch! Carl thanks me like I'm leaving. Is he breaking up with me? Is it because of Louis? Then he says Signet is gone. She killed herself. She was supposed to give me my BODY. There is a naiad golem on the floor, my cousin, and the teacher says Signet wants Carl to take it and find a Pulpmancer. TAKE IT, CARL. He does. Then I fly down through a hole in the floor.

beats.headline: Back, and wanting her body
beats.text: I FLEW BACK. Through the brambles and right up to the door, all by myself. Carl, my cousin gave you her mother, and her mother is a perfectly good body sitting in your inventory. We need a mage to animate her. A pulpmancer. Let's go right now! He says we just landed on a new floor and need to get our bearings first. I tell him I'm going to kill his mother. He says he won't help me if I keep threatening him. So I growl, and I go and chase Mongo.

beats.headline: Recon, and a rat in a hat
beats.text: I am the recon specialist. Carl says observe and report, head south and keep going, and find a mage. I tell him I will fuck up any monsters. He says no. I bounce down the stairs and ask a strolling couple if they are a mage. They are ghosts, apparently. NOBODY IS TALKING TO ME, AND IT HURTS MY FEELINGS. It takes a long time for my magic to build up, so I am not flying. Then I see a rat monster wearing a hat much too big for his little head, and he runs away. He is really fast.

beats.headline: She ate me
beats.text: GOOD NEWS AND BAD NEWS. I found a big boss mage, the right kind to get me into my body. She told me so. During. The bad news is she ate me, and it is very squishy in here. You have to come get me. She's kinda like a spider, a demigod, a lot smaller than most minor goddesses, with a sticky web over her whole swamp, down on the southern coast near the mouth of the big bay. I hitched a ride. She says she's looking for her husband. Her fangs have a very lovely shimmer to them.

beats.headline: Out of the spider, into the web
beats.text: The spider will NOT let me go. I am tied up in her web, and has anyone come for me? No. So when Donut finally unmutes me, I have things to say, and I say them at the correct volume, and she mutes me AGAIN. She MUTES me.

beats.headline: A new friend who can cast it
beats.text: Carl. Donut. FINALLY. I have made a friend. Her name is Shi Maria, and she can cast the spell. The spell. The body one. I have been telling everyone for two floors that this is possible, and now I have someone who can actually do it agreeing with me, so everyone can stop making that face. Come and get me so I can introduce you. I have a lot to tell you and none of it is quiet.

beats.headline: The whole plan, in order
beats.text: MaeMae casts the spell and I get my body. We kill lots of bad guys. We go to Larracos, I find my baby girl, I have a short, torrid affair with Louis and run away crying. Girls' night, matching shirts, NO CARL. Then I find my king, then MaeMae's husband, then I go home and kill my mother. Then MaeMae clicks something about supplies, and she cannot actually cast it. I tell her I am going to kill her mother. She bursts into tears. I forgive her. She gets panic attacks.

beats.headline: Blue, and then nothing
beats.text: The wolves are coming, the little brat in the tuxedo has locked Donut's deck and burned MaeMae's card, and nobody is doing anything. So I do something. I rise up and I glow, bright crackling blue like a tiny sun, hot enough that Carl steps back, and the brat shouts nein, nein and starts backing away like he knows. Watch this, I say. And then I fizzle out and fall in the grass. God mother damnit. I used it all up.

beats.headline: Past Clarabelle with a dirty Shirley
beats.text: The doorkeeper has never noticed the pass on my neck, and I tell her about a goddess in the Nothing who sells sushi made of her own innards, and that I am going to kill her mother. Carl clamps my jaw shut and tells her I just want a drink, and pays her a coin. So I am IN. I roll straight to the bar and tell the badger to feed me my cherries one at a time off his claws. His name is Charles. He wants to see gold.

beats.headline: Charles and I will kick her ass
beats.text: Carl tells me to be mean to the bartender, and then not to hurt him, which is a very confusing assassination. Charles could be my soulmate. Samantha Ellis has a nice ring to it. Charles comes with me, and he is very heavy. And there is a casino, jingly jangly and pretty, and one of the ways into the Nothing is in there, and out comes Minge. Charles and I will kick her ass. Now she is shouting my name. I have that bitch right where I want her.

beats.headline: You killed my boyfriend
beats.text: Charles and I are on a date. His arm is stuck, and I am practising my Kegels, which Donut taught me. Carl is rude about it. Then Minge's arm comes through the doorway and grabs Chuckie, and pulls, and I am holding a shoulder and a head. YOU KILLED MY BOYFRIEND. The rest of him falls out of me with some gold. She is Slit's little sister, and we used to be friends. At least it was not Gash. We need to go clubbing more often.

beats.headline: You talk in your sleep
beats.text: Everyone in the guild is asleep in a heap, strippers and changeling children, soaked from a water balloon fight. Not me. I go to say something and Carl shushes me and PATS MY HEAD, so I snap at him. Then he sleeps in a chair in Donut's room, and the social media board is right there, and I get it turned back on, because it has things to read. LET ME READ IT, or I will find your mother. He wakes up. I tell him the truth. He talks in his sleep.

beats.headline: Recon, and a cat lady on the snake
beats.text: Carl throws me and I GLOW. Recon mission. I report everything. A giant freshwater snake coiled on the beach, covered in ZOMBIE baby seals and crabs. Living seals singing, living crabs dancing, guts everywhere, the ocean frothing and red. It is like a party at Yarilo's place with less weird sex and NO CATERING. And a cat lady riding the snake's head, reciting poetry. All poetry sucks.

beats.headline: The whole beach, brought back
beats.text: The plan was for me to chomp the cat lady and be pulled back with her. I DID THE CHOMP, and I helped with the spell. What arrives around Carl is me, the nun, her snake, which is a level 125 city boss, about a thousand zombie baby seals, five thousand zombie crabs, every fish in the world, and a lot of corpses with demon names over them. It breaks her charm. Zero demons, though.

beats.headline: My dark secret
beats.text: Carl wants to know what I can do. Fine. I fly. I make spells stronger, only sometimes a lot stronger than I meant, and sometimes my magic does things without asking. I cannot teleport. There, now he knows I'm USELESS, a FRAUD, and he will tell Louis. He says I'm part of the team. Really? Then why doesn't he just do what the scary lady does, with the traps? Apparently now he could kiss me. I am not a whore, Carl.

beats.headline: Who Amayon is
beats.text: Carl asks who Amayon is. You know the four crown princes of Sheol? The oldest calls himself the King even though his mommy is in charge. Amayon is that guy's brother, the youngest, I think. We didn't mix with the down-there guys. He wasn't in the Nothing with us. He likes to set things on fire, kinda like Emberus, and they don't like each other.

beats.headline: A tail bite and a zombie parade
beats.text: Are we keeping the round guy? He's really cute. I want to name him. Carl throws me three times before I land close enough to Donut, and then I fly ten more minutes and bite her tail, hard, because I need a tight grip and I have a strong jaw game. I learned all about biting when SOMEBODY left me to get eaten by two doggies on the last floor. She gets teleported to Carl and throws up. Then I lead a whole crowd of zombies away down the street, shouting, so they can get past.

beats.headline: What the big snake is casting
beats.text: Do you like my new headband? Donut says it is quite lovely. Anyway, obviously I know what he's casting. He's fighting the charm, and he's making a portal home, the kind they try all the time in the Nothing, and it never works there because he needs to suck in lots and lots of souls. Big boys need big doors. His will be in the sky, and it will slurp everything up like your little cleaning robot. The Donut-looking lady isn't strong enough to hold him. She's got help. She probably worships another god. Carl says she doesn't.

beats.headline: I did not do that
beats.text: Elle's hail comes down at level sixteen and Carl asks if I did that. I am glowing. I am stronger too, and I did not do it. I hear myself talking while I spin: Elle is earth and water, the four seasons path, it's the tree, he's opening a path through the river and the tree, it's good she's not fire yet, gotta kill her, no, not Elle, her mother, no, not her mother. Then I stop. What just happened? Carl, did you roofie me again? And you need to stop gaslighting me.

beats.headline: Ysalte, honey, it has been ages
beats.text: Ysalte! Honey! It has been SO long! I invite her to my bachelorette party and ask after the child. Meanwhile I tell Louis in capitals to run before this bitch melts his beautiful ass into oatmeal. She calls me Psamathe and wants to know how I dare show myself after what I did. What did I do? The reverse hedgehog? That was ages ago, everyone at the party thought it was funny, except the hedgehog, and her. It isn't my fault she can't take a joke about how ugly her child is. She swings a pickaxe at my face. It bounces off.

beats.headline: We need to break up
beats.text: Carl. We need to break up. I have been thinking about it, and I have decided to go back to my king. He says okay. I hope we can stay friends. Then I growl at Louis, obviously, and go. At the church I remind Carl he is bringing MaeMae to the next floor, because she knows where the guy with my body is. He says not to worry about that. He knows where to go.

beats.headline: My arch enemy, Tish
beats.text: I am ROLLING after Tish, my arch enemy, and I am very fast, and then this DOPPELGANGER catches me in a corner and will not let go. I tell everyone I will kill her mother and uninvite her from my bachelorette party. I am a woman scorned. My need for revenge is the only thing I know, and I will not be denied. Then Donut says if I come back I can see her new cloak. That does sound exciting. Okay. Did Carl show them his new pet yet? He promised I could name him.

beats.headline: They got married without me
beats.text: THEY GOT MARRIED WITHOUT TELLING ME. Louis and the changeling. I wouldn't have disrupted the wedding. The little gnome says I said I'd push her over and take her place at the last second, but she's a child and does not understand the intricacies of modern love. And even if I was going to, that is no reason not to tell a girl. Then Donut says that was only the first wedding, and there's a bigger ceremony in a few weeks. Why didn't anyone SAY so? This changes everything.

beats.headline: I am doing my part
beats.text: I AM DOING MY PART IN THE WAR, CARL. I sneaked onto the plane, and Carl says I'm not a scout and I'll tear a Samantha-sized hole in it at the border. FINE. Louis and I will crash together and build a log cabin, and he will grow a scraggly beard that smells like a campfire. Then Carl tells Louis to dump me out of the bomb bay. No, WAIT. Louis can just come back. It's a suicide mission. I like him more than Charlie. I don't want him to die yet.

beats.headline: Dropped out of the airplane
beats.text: Louis ACCIDENTALLY DROPPED ME OUT OF HIS AIRPLANE. Now I am covered in leaves and dirt and I have to spit it out of my mouth. There's Tina crunching robots like soda cans, and Mongo and the meatball digging the meat out of them like a crab bake. Did you guys have another PARTY without telling me? Carl says that was only the preview. The big fight is about to begin.

beats.headline: Nobody mention his mother
beats.text: I get onto the goat's dragon and shout KISS! KISS! and whisper something to her that makes her crackle, and he tells me to remove myself from his mount. Oh yeah? Make me. Don't walk away from me, Mr. Goat Man! I'm going to kill... and Katia's giant hand is over my mouth. Then she and Carl lecture me. Don't mention his mother. Not to him. BUT YOU PROMISED, CARL. How is it my fault that someone else got to his mother before I could? I bite his finger and roll away.

beats.headline: I open the god's door
beats.text: The bug god's door will not open for a heathen. It will open for someone damned, and Mordecai, Tipid and Rosetta are all certain that I count. Carl tells me to get over there, and don't you dare touch the dial, and then he checks with a screenshot that I didn't. I didn't. I hop into his hands and he holds me up to the door like a football. You'll have to use your mouth, he says. I don't even say anything filthy. I just say okay, Carl, and I chomp down on the handle and pull.

beats.headline: My mother is a boy eagle
beats.text: YOU TOLD ME I COULD GO KILL MY MOTHER, CARL. So I went to her temple, and she was an eagle! A boy eagle! My mother is not like Diwata. She can't just grow a dingaling. I'm burnt to a husk and my hair is smoking and Miss Me? is still on my forehead, and there's a slug with a hatchet trying to hit me. And the orc lady was there too, telling the imposter he wouldn't be allowed to help. She's in on the conspiracy! Momnapper! Where is my mother? Tell me now or I'll kill yours!

beats.headline: Victory rolls for the GIs
beats.text: Where have I been? Entertaining the GIs, Carl. Soldiers always need comfort just before a major battle. Kiwi did my hair. They're called victory rolls, and for a one-eyed preggo who used to be a dinosaur she has very deft fingers. Mordecai showed the kids war movies to put them off fighting and I loved every one of them. Now I'm on Carl's lap in the airship, between the bombs, and my forehead says Fuck the Cheese Dicks. Carl says it's cheese STICKS. Why would there be a tree made out of cheese?

beats.headline: An officer, and a spell
beats.text: It's a bleached drake. They make very cute pets, and they have gravity magic, so Louis's airship is going to get smushed like a can of Louis-flavoured soup. Carl says he'll make me an officer so I get a spell called Paint the Target, and I'm to paint the dragon and then tell Bomo and Sledge. Bomo and Sledge are big nerds and I do not want to be seen talking to them. It's to help Louis. Oh, all right. Also the gate just timed out, all crackly and sparkly. I can take the bitch.

beats.headline: A god, not a demon
beats.text: Boomer says start moving. You don't have to tell me twice. This is a god, not a demon. It's Yarilo, and he doesn't like me, because he thinks I helped get him tossed in the Nothing. It's not my fault he's attracted to animals. No offence, Katia. And now he's bellowing across the whole realm. PSAMATHE! Are you here? We need to talk! Wait, don't run! By his left tit, stop running! I am running. Boomer says angle toward the castle, but not too close.

beats.headline: A hall pass night
beats.text: The Reaver castle is empty except for the robot doggies, who are everywhere, and the hallways are super small and complicated, and I am looking. Then Juice Box says she has a fleshmancer form and I can have any body I desire if I bring her husband back in one piece. Throw in a hall pass night with Louis and you have a deal. She says she knows who I really am and I've lost my mind. Okay, it's a deal. But if Louis's passions get the best of him, I won't make any apologies.

beats.headline: I saved him
beats.text: THE ROBOT DOGGIES ARE GOING CRAZY. I think they know Carl is here. Don't kill all of them. I want Buster, the one with his lower jaw removed. I took his explodey part off. They don't blow up near me, because of our SPECIAL BOND. Then a lot of things blow up at once, and I come down out of the sky on fire and stick in the ground next to everybody. I am a scorched ball now, with one curl left. I saved him. You're welcome. Now where's my new doggie?

beats.headline: Louis deserves it more
beats.text: Carl. I think my child is dead. She died in the acid. I felt her, and now I don't, and it is my fault; I was too caught up in my own lust and anger. After this I am going to plant the nuke I took off Buster up at the college. But the IMPORTANT part: Princess Lunette's flesh golem. Good heart. Good lungs. Swap them fast enough and Louis lives. Yes, that means no body for me. Louis deserves it more. And a girl can find forgiveness for maybe helping kill Geyrun, right?

beats.headline: Kimmy, remembered
beats.text: HE'S NOT TOUCHING ME ANYMORE. Bring me back! He was going to EAT me, but I had him throw me in a volcano like Carl said, and now he's blowing up the world. Then Bautista says Carl has a Kimaris figure. KIMMY! Give him to me! He's one of my best friends. He gave me the potion that put my baby in me when I couldn't get pregnant. Why couldn't I remember that? He gave me advice on who to date. His MOTHER! I will kill his mother!

beats.headline: She claims Carl's room
beats.text: Carl's room is MY room now. He never goes in it, and honestly I won it in the breakup. The sluggies are doing the wallpaper, the carpet is from the Larracos College of Magic, and the chandelier is a chandelier, whatever the Crocodilian kid says about it being a swing. Anything that lights up and hangs from the ceiling is a chandelier. Then I explain the entire ninth floor to Tipid, perfectly, and Bigs agrees it was perfect. Tipid says he is good. He is VERY SERIOUS. I do not trust people who are VERY SERIOUS.

beats.headline: Dibs on the makeup
beats.text: A garbage mountain comes out of Carl's snake box, and I call dibs on any makeup before anybody else can open their mouth. I go in. There is a palette with Donut's face on it, which I bring out for her, and she is not nearly as grateful as she should be. Then there is a lipstick from her brand, a colour called Pussy Lips, and it has already been used, which means it is MINE. It is on my lips now. They practically glow. You are welcome, everybody.

beats.headline: The skin of his vanquished enemies
beats.text: RAWR. Carl comes back from the race wearing a dead kangaroo and hopping, and I love it when a man wears the skin of his vanquished enemies. Can we get an ogre corpse for Louis to wear? Imagine how sexy that would be. Everyone else is being boring about it. Hedy says it has ruined her lady boner, which is her problem. I roll circles around him, snuffling. Also, Carl, when can I take your truck for a spin? Nobody answers that one either.

beats.headline: Victorious again, at Mario Kart
beats.text: VICTORIOUS AGAIN. Mario Kart, Princess Peach, pink motorcycle, the controller in my mouth and the buttons pressed with my tongue, and nobody in this safe room can touch me except Tipid and one large slug. The deal was that the losers become my slaves for all eternity. Apparently the deal was a sick compliment. Fine. One says I am not as psychotic as he first thought. The other says if I were a strawberry he would nibble me. Carl says no threatening. I only mentioned their mothers.

beats.headline: Carl's room is hers now
beats.text: Hey, that was NOT my fault. I told Gluteus about the stuff. He took it on his own. He took too much, and now he owes me money, so if anyone is keeping score, I am the victim here. Also I have a room. It used to be Carl's room, but he never goes in it because he lives in the bathroom, so I redecorated. New wallpaper. The sluggalos say it is badass. Carl has not seen it yet. He is going to LOVE it.

beats.headline: Chachi
beats.text: Why does Carl smell like Chachi? Chalchiuhtlicue. Green skirt, talks funny, cries a lot. Don't hide her from me, I'm not jealous. Okay, I don't usually give advice after a breakup, but: she's pretty, and she is CUCKOO. Always talking about saving children, and then something inconvenient happens and it's sacrifice a seven-year-old. She had a whole village day care killed at a Yarilo party over cilantro in the meatballs. It worked, though. And now Carl is triple-dipping with her and Eris and a wife? No mustache, even.

beats.headline: I'm stealing that line
beats.text: I float in at exactly the good part, and Carl yelps, which is RUDE. Dong quotes a beautiful line about sad endings, and I am stealing it for when Carl lets me drive and I crash the car. Then I meet the half-man in the gimp suit. He is only half as handsome as advertised. Carl drags me out before anything happens, and I have QUESTIONS. If they get glued back together and one half has been with the other half's man, is that cheating on himself? And how exactly are they being glued?

beats.headline: The fleshmancer is MINE
beats.text: I KNEW it. They have been HIDING a fleshmancer from me. Grigori the Placid, the most renowned flesh sculptor this dungeon has ever known, allegedly, and he looks like a creepy-van grandpa, which is not my type. I tell him the plan: into town, a compatible body, there's a prostitute called Vertical Smile at the High-Classes Bitches club who might match, and if we go now we beat the lunch rush. He picks me up, turns me over and says he must examine me properly. Fine. My place. Shoes off. Mind the new rug.

beats.headline: My plan is a secret too
beats.text: I left the fleshmancer talking to Jamal about his legs. I don't think he's properly qualified. He didn't even gasp when he entered Sam Town, and you are SUPPOSED to gasp at luxury. Now everyone is hiding in the stinky stables being secret about a plan, so I have a plan too, and mine is also a secret, which is how you know it works. Donut says Carl's plan is to get a bunch of immortals who hate each other to kill each other, and to die sad and alone. That is just like my plan!

beats.headline: Who else is going to drive
beats.text: Carl is a DOG. A long-haired wiener dog, with an accent, and he cannot drive because he has no thumbs, and Jamal is not very good, so who else is going to? Donut adds me as a driver. I take the steering wheel in my mouth. I hope the dog thing is permanent. We will have to change his name, of course, and get him neutered. Or maybe not. Orthrus is also a boy, which is a shame, because can you imagine the puppies?

beats.headline: Our torrid affair, cancelled
beats.text: Louis says he's LEAVING. I am never going to see him again. We never even got to have our TORRID AFFAIR. We were going to fall madly in love, and when I went back to my king he was going to pluck his own eyes out. Now he'll be all alone, and I have nobody left for an affair. Carl is too broody, and a dog. Jurgen's Heidi sounds meaner than Imani. Florin is a crocodile. Prepotente asks what about him. Ew.

beats.headline: One chance for Prepotente
beats.text: LOUIS JUMPED DOWN A HOLE. I said I would go with him and he said no, which is RUDE, and now I am sobbing. Fine. Prepotente. You get one chance. You have to shave your whole body, and you have to bring Bianca in on it, and you have to be okay with me calling you Louis. And you can't scream. That was screaming. You can't do that.

beats.headline: She knows the donkey
beats.text: I KNOW THAT DONKEY. That's my friend! That's LAMMY! Lammy is REALLY grumpy about people trying to ride her, believe me, so she must like that wolf guy with the microphone, or why is she letting him? Then the Destruction float fires every gun it has at once, and the tank goes like a thunderclap, and I like fireworks.

beats.headline: She hitches a ride
beats.text: OKAY, CARL. I am going. Look me up when you get to the Ascendency. Don't mess up Sam Town, I used stuff from that snake guy's house you killed to decorate it. Now I am hovering by a very big god's ear, whispering, and he looks surprised, and he grabs me out of the air. Taranis and Krakaren and me. See you.

beats.headline: Here to kill the demon mother
beats.text: HI, LOUIS! I see you in chat. I hitched a ride with Taranis and Krakaren. They're at the temple trying to combine a bunch of things to make his mom wife whole, and it won't work, because they are missing a piece. I slipped away. It is all part of my plan. I am really here to kill the demon mother lady and her jerk son, who tricked me into giving birth to a monster that will destroy all of creation. Doesn't that sound fun? What are you wearing?
